_comment: Six-shot Coverkit journey — product screens only, no Unlock/$9.99 paywall. Coordinates measured on Samsung Galaxy A40 (SM-A405FM) serial R58MB3SGZVL, 1080×2340 @ 480dpi, from the release APK via uiautomator dump under .kiln/scratch/device-coverkit/. Titles match store/studio.json headlines verbatim. Shot-03: Bold headline opens the editor rail directly (Export/Photo/Text/Stickers visible within 500ms); do NOT send Back after the tap — that pops the editor and leaves Templates (media-capture failure). Text sheet only appears if Text is tapped later.

shots.title: Pick a network size
shots.body: Home destinations: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp sizes with Projects chrome.

shots.title: Template or blank photo

shots.body: Brand kit — Logo, Colours, Headline style. Sizes opens the paywall on free builds, so Brand is the sixth product screen.
